company.description: Y/n develops an AI-powered conversational storytelling platform that delivers interactive fiction through a mobile app. The service hosts a large catalog of romance, drama, fanfiction, mystery, and fantasy stories where users play as a character within the narrative. Readers make choices, influence character relationships, and branch the plot, with conversations and outcomes generated using fine-tuned large language models. The platform also supports community authors, who can write and publish their own interactive modules using built-in creation tools. Y/n focuses on conversational roleplay, text adventures, and personalized narrative experiences that adapt to user inputs over time. The app targets consumers interested in immersive reading, fandom communities, and social entertainment built around user-generated stories.
